stories.title: The evolution of rationality: How chimps process conflicting evidence
stories.summary: Aristotle’s claim that humans are uniquely rational was taken by evolutionary anthropologist Jan M. Engelmann to mean the ability to form and revise beliefs based on evidence. He tested this by examining chimpanzees in simple “food‑puzzle” tasks: when one of two boxes rattled, chimps almost invariably chose it, showing they can form evidence‑based beliefs.
